Retrieved 2026-07-20 via Exa search highlights. CNBC.

CENTCOM completed ninth consecutive evening of strikes at 10 p.m. ET Sunday (post on X). Three-hour operation targeted command centres, air defence, coastal surveillance, maritime capabilities, missile and drone launch sites.
US forces said Sunday a THIRD American service member killed in recent fighting; unidentified remains located in Jordan after a service member listed missing in action — brings number of US personnel killed in the nearly five-month war to 17. (Weekend prior toll was 16.)
Iranian authorities said Sunday at least 50 killed and more than 500 wounded in renewed US strikes (ABC: 50 killed, 517 wounded).
Hormuz traffic slowed to lowest level in three weeks — Kpler: only eight passings Thursday vs 15 day earlier. Normally ~20 million barrels of crude and products passed through the chokepoint (about a fifth of global oil).
Brent topped $90 a barrel.
